weekly_digest.period_label: 近 7 日全球 AI 大事周报（截至 2026-11-20）
weekly_digest.summary: 本周共收录 37 项国内外 AI 关键进展（海外 19 · 国内 10 · 开源生态 22）。主线聚焦三大方向：1）中美头部旗舰模型进入新一轮迭代与商业化验证；2）端侧中小参数与开源推理引擎持续拉低个人电脑本地运行门槛；3）多模态世界模型与编程 Agent 加速落地真实开发工作流。
weekly_digest.summary_en: Tracked 37 AI milestones this week (19 global, 10 China, 22 open-source). Key themes: flagship model competition, local/edge open-weight breakthroughs, and multimodal & coding agents entering production.

items.title: 谷歌发布Gemini 4 Neon，兼顾速度与成本的复杂任务模型
items.title_en: Google Launches Gemini 4 Neon, a Model for Complex Tasks Balancing Speed and Cost
items.what_it_does: 谷歌推出了Gemini 4 Neon，定位介于旗舰Carbon和轻量Hydrogen之间，旨在以Flash级别的速度和更低的成本完成复杂的软件工程、知识工作和科研工作流任务，提供100万Token上下文窗口并支持多模态输入。
items.what_it_does_en: Google launched Gemini 4 Neon, positioned between the flagship Carbon and lightweight Hydrogen models, designed to complete complex software engineering, knowledge work, and research workflows at Flash-level speed and lower cost, offering a 1 million token context window and multimodal input support.
items.who_cares: 需要高效处理复杂任务、对成本和速度有较高要求的软件工程师、研究人员和知识工作者。
items.limitations: 该模型为闭源模型，具体API定价和访问权限可能有所限制。
items.limitations_en: This is a closed-source model, and specific API pricing and access may be limited.

timeline.title: 腾讯混元Hy4 flash发布，以超高性价比登顶OpenRouter日榜
timeline.title_en: Tencent Hunyuan Hy4 flash Released, Topping OpenRouter Daily Chart with High Cost-Effectiveness
timeline.what_it_does: 腾讯混元推出轻量级多模态模型Hy4 flash，以极低的推理成本（输入每百万Token 0.5元）提供接近旗舰模型的性能，支持1M上下文长度，上线首日Token调用量突破50万亿，并登顶全球大模型聚合平台OpenRouter的LLM日榜首位。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Tencent Hunyuan launched the lightweight multimodal model Hy4 flash, offering near-flagship performance at extremely low inference costs (0.5 RMB per million input tokens), supporting a 1M context length. On its launch day, it achieved over 50 trillion token calls and topped OpenRouter's LLM daily chart.
timeline.who_cares: 追求高性价比、需要处理大量日常办公任务（如PPT制作、文档编辑）的AI平台工程师、LLM应用架构师和企业级AIGC产品负责人。
timeline.limitations: 该模型为闭源模型，主要通过API调用，但提供限时免费试用和折扣。
timeline.limitations_en: This is a closed-source model, primarily accessed via API, but offers limited-time free trials and discounts.
